svg.text: PROPOSAL • Owner approval pending • Reference only, not device evidence
• Current forecast facts and exact selected instant stay live
• Timeline and World gestures stay in their existing owner
• No forecast text or data becomes part of the PNGs
• A missing image retains the old complete scene
• Preserve common transform, alpha and painter order
• No night, seasons, rain/snow or sprite motion yet
Fit & safe-area mapping • duplicated semantic props • fallback handoff • bitmap memory on Pixel 3 XL
Baked-in daylight, wet pavement and lamps are acknowledged limitations, not a forecast claim.
